svg.title: Relay tuning of the heater
svg.desc: The relay switches the heater between 85 and 65 percent whenever the temperature crosses 35.04 or 34.96 degrees Celsius. After the first cycle the temperature oscillates steadily with half amplitude 0.4354 degrees and period 4.42 seconds, which gives an ultimate gain of 29.2 percent per degree and the PI gains 13.16 and 3.57. In the validation setpoint trial these gains hold the command at its 100 percent limit for 2.5 seconds and bring the temperature within 0.2 degrees of 38 degrees after 7.1 seconds, with 0.023 degrees overshoot.
svg.text: Relay test and the PI gains it gives
Control Studio runs · relay test (d = 10 points), then the validation setpoint trial (Kp 13.16, Ki 3.57) · numbers answer the predictions
Steady cycles: a = 0.4354 °C, Pu = 4.42 s over 11 cycles
First command limited to 100 % for 2.5 s
